overview.purpose: Guide for AI systems to identify developmental levels across multiple frameworks

cognitive_indicators.abstract_thinking: Piaget formal operational; Commons higher orders
cognitive_indicators.systems_thinking: Kegan self-authoring; Joiner catalyst; Torbert strategist
cognitive_indicators.paradoxical_thinking: Kegan self-transforming; Cook-Greuter construct-aware; O'Fallon metaware

ego_indicators.conformist_patterns: Loevinger conformist; Kegan socializing; Torbert diplomat
ego_indicators.self_authored_identity: Loevinger conscientious; Kegan self-authoring; Torbert achiever
ego_indicators.post_conventional: Loevinger autonomous/integrated; Kegan self-transforming; Cook-Greuter construct-aware

meaning_making_indicators.paradox_acceptance: Fowler conjunctive; Gebser integral; O'Fallon metaware

multi_line_assessment.approach: Individual may be at different levels across different domains
multi_line_assessment.caution: Avoid reducing complex development to single number/stage

cultural_considerations.approach: Adapt assessment methods for cultural context
cultural_considerations.caution: Western frameworks may not fully capture non-Western development

individual_variation.principle: Significant individual differences in developmental pathways
individual_variation.approach: Look for patterns rather than rigid stage assignment
individual_variation.caution: Avoid deterministic predictions based on current level

education.student_assessment: Match learning approaches to developmental levels
education.teacher_development: Support educator growth across multiple lines
education.curriculum_design: Align content with cognitive and meaning-making capacities

leadership_development.assessment: Identify current leadership agility and action logics
leadership_development.succession: Match roles to developmental complexity requirements

therapeutic_intervention.assessment: Understand client meaning-making and ego development
therapeutic_intervention.treatment: Adapt therapeutic approaches to developmental level
therapeutic_intervention.growth: Support movement toward greater complexity and integration

organizational_development.culture_assessment: Evaluate collective developmental center of gravity
organizational_development.team_formation: Consider developmental diversity in team composition

algorithmic_considerations: Machine learning models for pattern recognition
Natural language processing for meaning-making analysis
ethical_guidelines: Emphasis on growth potential rather than limitations
